d:
US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has reportedly been moved from his Washington residence to a military base following Iranian threats against his life. Bessent leads the Trump administration's economic pressure campaign against Tehran.
In a separate case, the US Justice Department has indicted three alleged Iranian-backed operatives over nearly 20 terrorist attacks and attempted attacks across Europe and the United States. The indictment also details an alleged September 2026 plot targeting RAF Fairford, a British military base housing American personnel and aircraft.
